tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Read per-endpoint availability, dataset freshness, and payment state. Overpass serves the global OpenStreetMap planet; this reports the dataset timestamp, which endpoints are up, and whether pay-per-query can currently settle. Free.

tools.name: basemap_catalog
tools.description: Discover CARTO Dark Matter and Positron raster tile templates plus the OpenMapTiles vector tile template, with each source's zoom range, snapshot date, attribution, and header authentication. tools.name: elevation
tools.description: Sample ground elevation in meters at lat/lon. elevationMeters is a surface height floored at sea level, so a point at sea reads 0 and belowSeaLevel marks it; sampledMeters carries the raw reading and bathymetryTile names the public raster to read the sea floor from. Requires a subscription API key;

tools.name: route
tools.description: Compute a turn-by-turn route between 2 and 10 waypoints for auto, bicycle, pedestrian, truck, motor_scooter, or bus. tools.name: isochrone
tools.description: Compute reachable-area polygons from one point for up to four travel-time bands in minutes. Returns GeoJSON polygons usable for catchment, coverage, and site-selection analysis. Requires a subscription key; shares REST quota. Covers the global road graph.

tools.name: overpass_query
tools.description: Execute Overpass QL over the global OpenStreetMap planet: nodes, ways, relations, arbitrary tags, geometry, generated areas, metadata, recursion, and bounded spatial search. Subscription or approved x402 payment required. No historical attic queries. Call service_status for the dataset timestamp.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: geo_style · Private data: elevation, geo_search · Public sink: geo_search · Destructive: geo_style, geo_analyze, overpass_query.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: geo_style · Private data: elevation, geo_search · Public sink: geo_search · Destructive: geo_style, geo_analyze, overpass_query

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
